system.description: Fifty-four cards, two of them Jokers, every edge filed and set with razor-tin (the Card Slinger's class feature Razor deck). It never needs retrieving. Each throw draws a card, and the card sets the damage: d4 for a 2 to 5, d6 for a 6 to 10, d8 for a knave, queen or king, d10 for an ace, d12 for a Joker (and you take d4 slashing damage). Shuffle it with its button (an Interact action); it is shuffled whole when an encounter ends.
